title: No one hurt in 2 firecracker factory explosions in Bulacan

blocks.text: CAMP GEN. ALEJO SANTOS, Bulacan – Explosions rocked two firecracker factories in Bocaue and Baliwag City, Bulacan, on Tuesday, but no one was hurt. Three workers managed to flee to safety when a shanty that has been serving as a firecracker factory exploded at past 10 a.m. in Sitio Caculisan, Barangay Bambang in Bocaue, according to a report from Maj. Jaynalyn Udal, Bulacan Provincial Police Office Information Officer. Police recovered the workers’ identification cards near a firework stockroom with a “Seg-Sabel Fireworks” sign.
